name: opencode-worker
description: Control OpenCode from Codex as a guarded local execution worker.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate Codex plans to OpenCode and wait for completion.
interface.longDescription: Use OpenCode Worker to let Codex launch, monitor, and wait for non-interactive OpenCode runs in the local workspace. The plugin prevents overlapping OpenCode jobs and intentionally exposes no interrupt or kill command.
defaultPrompt: Plan this change, then delegate the implementation to OpenCode.
Check whether OpenCode is running and wait for it.
Show the latest OpenCode worker logs.
